EXECUTIVE MONOGRAPH SUMMARY

Why Conventional Cybersecurity Collapses Against Autonomous AI

An executive analysis of non-deterministic systems, national security exposure, and the urgent imperative for cognitive cyber defense.

THE PARADIGM SHIFT

From Deterministic Code to Probabilistic Risk

For four decades, enterprise cybersecurity was predicated on a fundamental assumption: software is deterministic. Input A predictably yields Output B. Firewalls, intrusion prevention systems, and endpoint detection agents enforce static boundary rules.

Autonomous artificial intelligence breaks this model entirely. Neural networks operate as non-deterministic stochastic matrices. When placed in command of municipal water purification valves, automated frequency regulation in power grids, or hospital triage routing, an adversary does not need to crack passwords—they manipulate weights, inject invisible mathematical perturbations, or leverage indirect prompt injection to commandeer physical actuators.

"A conventional software vulnerability causes a data leak. An AI vulnerability in critical infrastructure causes kinetic destruction, blackouts, and loss of life." — CyberSeal6X Strategic Operating Doctrine
